summary: Added a branded launch screen and optional per-app opening snapshots.

changes.title: A branded opening screen
changes.description: HTMLApp shows its icon as iOS starts it, then shows the saved app’s name and icon while its page opens.

changes.title: Preview your saved app while it opens
changes.description: In an app’s Permissions, turn on Save an opening preview. HTMLApp keeps a snapshot on this device and refreshes it after an edit or update.

summary: Added live screen context for Forge edits and improved HTML repair, responsive layout, and storage checks.

changes.title: Forge sees the screen you’re editing
changes.description: Edits use the current layout automatically. You can also opt to send a screenshot with an edit. The in-app Report Screen menu has been removed.

changes.title: More accurate app checks
changes.description: Forge waits for WebKit to resize, tests what’s actually selected in a dropdown, and closes complete HTML documents that are missing their final tag.

changes.title: Better recovery from rejected repairs
changes.description: Forge retries a rejected edit block with the matching error and nearby source before asking you to retry the checks.

summary: Added immediate Forge generation feedback, improved verification and repair, enabled multi-file app updates, and added pasted skill import.

changes.title: See when Forge is starting
changes.description: Generate shows a spinner during preparation and transcription. Once the build starts, Forge shows its progress.

changes.title: More reliable Forge checks
changes.description: Forge can apply multi-part repairs and rerun workflow checks. After two failed retries, you can choose to save the draft with unresolved checks.

changes.title: Import and update several apps at once
changes.description: Select multiple files in Files. Matching HTML app names and icons update the existing apps while keeping their data.

changes.title: Paste a Forge skill
changes.description: Import Markdown files or paste the contents of a skill directly into Forge.

summary: Added native walking routes, reliable nearby category searches, and more precise Forge workflow diagnostics.

changes.title: Walking directions inside your apps
changes.description: Forge can use Apple Maps to show walking steps, routed miles, and estimated minutes inside generated apps.

changes.title: Search more nearby categories
changes.description: Category lookups run in sequence, and an app can use a confirmed school or other venue as its search center. Forge prioritizes the installed map tools over unrelated API suggestions.

changes.title: Clearer app checks and retries
changes.description: Forge identifies the exact control and display mode when a workflow fails. Retry keeps the last failure in view so repairs can use it.

summary: Added Lock Screen voice context, per-app Forge memory, private destination handoff, interactive edit previews, and stronger verification and recovery.

changes.title: Add context from the Lock Screen
changes.description: Choose camera photos, library photos, files, or skills before sending a voice request to Forge.

changes.title: Test Alternative before recording
changes.description: On the Lock Screen widget screen, say a few words and tap the purple mic. You’ll see the result, and a separate prompt recording starts right after.

changes.title: Build apps around your current place
changes.description: Forge can use Apple Maps for nearby venue candidates and foreground driving estimates. Confirm your destination once and keep the estimate updated as you move.

changes.title: Forge remembers each app
changes.description: Forge uses relevant past requests, style feedback and revision summaries. Review, exclude or pin context in What Forge Remembers.

changes.title: Know what changed and what stayed
changes.description: Edit History shows the requests and checks for saved changes. Restoring an earlier version updates which revisions Forge considers active.

changes.title: Point Forge at the right screen
changes.description: Select an element before asking for a change, or send a screen report with its last control and recent errors. Review files, skills and history in Request Context.

changes.title: Try both versions before saving
changes.description: Switch between the previous and edited previews. Preview data is separate from your saved app.

changes.title: Keep your confirmed destination
changes.description: Choose a nearby venue during generation and the saved app can use it after you leave. Forge checks movement, driving estimates, denied location and route failures.

changes.title: Check existing features after an edit
changes.description: Forge gives complex edits more verification, checks sample records and tests declared workflows. Repair notes explain what changed and whether the retest passed.

changes.title: Recover work after an interruption
changes.description: Reopen a completed draft or rerun checks on saved source when a build is interrupted. Work History shows preview time, saved results and repair outcomes.

summary: Forge automatically diagnoses, repairs and retests blocking app-check failures.

changes.title: Forge diagnoses and fixes failed checks
changes.description: When a blocking check fails, the Prompt Planner pinpoints the cause and the Coding Agent applies a targeted repair. Fast and Balanced both retest the result before accepting it.

changes.title: Prevent blank native tabs
changes.description: Forge now accounts for how HTMLApp shows each page when generating and repairing apps with native tabs.

summary: Replaced NoteTakers with an on-device mic test and added a short Apple Speech recording tail.

changes.title: Test Alternative dictation
changes.description: Speak, then drop the microphone on Test Mic to see whether it recognized any words. Alternative transcribes on device.

changes.title: Capture the end of a phrase
changes.description: Apple Speech keeps listening for 150 milliseconds after you release the microphone.

summary: Animated the four context tiles in and out of the microphone.

changes.title: Context options spring from the microphone
changes.description: Camera, Photos, Files, and Skills stretch into place as you drag inward and flow back into the microphone at the screen edge.

summary: Added a stretching outline for microphone context targets.

changes.title: Jelly motion for context targets
changes.description: The outline stretches and slides between context options, then springs back toward the microphone when you drag away.

summary: Added a microphone target outline and Liquid Glass context buttons.

changes.title: Clearer microphone context targets
changes.description: The target under the microphone now has an outline. Context buttons use Liquid Glass on iOS 26 and later.

summary: Added Discord release notes and preview images, plus expandable release history.

changes.title: What’s New in Discord
changes.description: IPA delivery includes the current release notes and a preview image when rendering succeeds.

changes.title: A cleaner release history
changes.description: Scan version groups with matching icons, then tap an item to open its description. Only one item is open at a time.

summary: Added Skills to microphone drag targets, improved skill selection and layout, and archived full release notes.

changes.title: Skills from the microphone
changes.description: Drag the microphone to Skills to choose guidance for a creation or edit request.

changes.title: Clearer context and skill selection
changes.description: Four context buttons fill the row. Pick multiple skills in the redesigned picker and toggle each one separately from your attached files.

changes.title: Full release notes in history
changes.description: Release history shows every saved What’s New item, including its description.

summary: Added release history, searchable Forge skills, and versioned Discord IPA delivery.

changes.title: See what changed since your last version
changes.description: Expand the release history below to catch up on versions you skipped.

changes.title: Bring your own Forge skills
changes.description: Import Markdown skills once, then search and attach them to creation and edit requests from Additional context.

changes.title: Versioned Discord builds
changes.description: IPA attachments and their Discord messages now identify the exact release.

summary: Limited online Forge transcription to one attempt per launch.

changes.title: Online voice once per launch
changes.description: Only the first voice recording for creating or editing an app uses the free online API. Later recordings use your selected Apple Speech or Alternative engine.

changes.title: Retries stay on device
changes.description: An unsuccessful online attempt still counts for this launch. Retry the saved audio on device without another upload. Practice recordings do not use the online attempt.

summary: Switched Forge dictation to free, keyless NoteTakers.

changes.title: Free voice transcription, no key
changes.description: Forge now uses NoteTakers for online prompt and edit transcription. No signup, API key, or payment setup is needed.

changes.title: Keep speaking when online is unavailable
changes.description: The free service allows 10 requests per day per IP address. Forge tries on-device transcription if the limit is reached or the service fails, and keeps failed recordings for retry.

changes.title: Your choice of voice engine
changes.description: Settings explains where online audio is sent. Turn off online transcription to use Apple Speech or Alternative instead.

summary: Added an optional Forge UI review, more symbols and gesture guidance, faster widget refresh requests, and online dictation.

changes.title: One more look at your UI
changes.description: After generation, choose an optional interface review. No is selected automatically after five seconds, and your working app is kept if refinement fails.

changes.title: Online voice for Forge
changes.description: Add a free-tier Groq key in Settings for online prompt and edit transcription, with on-device fallback and recording retry. Whisper is now labeled Alternative.

changes.title: Richer app building
changes.description: Forge has stronger workflow and touch-gesture guidance, broader SF Symbol choices, and a detailed guide updated for the current native APIs.

changes.title: Fresher widgets
changes.description: New widgets request 15-minute refreshes by default. Opening HTMLApp also checks for due data updates. iOS controls actual background timing.

summary: Queue attachment pickers until presentation is ready.

changes.title: More reliable attachment pickers
changes.description: Camera, Photos, and Files wait for the screen to be ready, including after a cold launch or another popup. Requests stay queued while the app is inactive.

changes.title: Smoother request review
changes.description: The picker closes fully before your review page opens. If a picker cannot open, a clear message lets you retry without silently losing the request.

summary: Improve attachment research and lifecycle; pause backends.

changes.title: Better research with references
changes.description: Forge can use attached documents and photos to identify what needs checking, then spend more time finding and reading relevant documentation.

changes.title: Keep adding photos and files
changes.description: Fixed competing picker presentations in Review Request. Camera, Photos, and Files now open from their own presentation state, with clear camera-access errors.

changes.title: Attachments stay with one task
changes.description: References clear after successful generation or cancellation, so they won’t carry into your next request. Images already embedded in your generated app remain available.

changes.title: Backends temporarily paused
changes.description: Forge no longer generates hosted backends. Backend operations and automatic setup are disabled while existing files, saved configuration, and backend code are kept.

summary: Add attachment review and prewarm Library for 1.9.17.

changes.title: Review before generating
changes.description: Camera, Photos, and Files now open a review page. Edit your transcript and choose Generate when you’re ready, or Cancel without sending a request.

changes.title: Build a complete reference set
changes.description: Mix up to nine photos and files in a three-column grid. Take another picture, add more references, or confirm removal with each attachment’s × button.

changes.title: Clear, familiar controls
changes.description: The review page uses Liquid Glass buttons on supported devices: blue Generate with white text and gray Cancel with red text.

changes.title: A smoother Library launch
changes.description: Normal launches prepare your saved Library before displaying it, avoiding the empty-library flash. Direct app links keep their fast launch path.

summary: Add voice attachment targets, durable app conversations and focused Forge progress.

changes.title: Show Forge what you mean
changes.description: Drag the edit microphone onto Camera, Photos, or Files. Select references, then Forge transcribes your request and uses the attachments for an edit or a new app.

changes.title: Keep moving through questions
changes.description: Forge asks only when a choice matters. After five seconds without interaction, or when you lock the screen, it continues with a practical default using the existing background generation support.

changes.title: Your app’s continuing story
changes.description: App Conversation keeps requests, technical edit summaries, reversions, and completed share events. Recent history informs later edits, and personal backups include the full log.

changes.title: A simpler generation screen
changes.description: Watch the live activity graph and Forge’s current status, with fewer distractions while it works.

summary: Restore pre-refresh widget behavior and add Refresh Widget Data shortcut.

changes.title: Previous widget behavior restored
changes.description: Removed the recent foreground refresh loop, automatic publication selection, and experimental rendering diagnostics and plain-text test.

changes.title: Refresh widgets with Shortcuts
changes.description: Add HTMLApp’s Refresh Widget Data action to a shortcut. It refreshes saved data bindings and approved native background data, then requests a widget reload. iOS controls display timing.

summary: Speed cold launches and add focused Lock Screen voice creation.

changes.title: Apps open faster
changes.description: Cold-start work is deferred, and URL links can open a cached saved app directly without loading or warming the Library first.

changes.title: Speak an app from the Lock Screen
changes.description: The Lock Screen microphone opens a focused recorder with an editable transcript and one-tap generation. Whisper performs a short cold-start warm-up before recording your prompt.

changes.title: Cleaner Settings and storage
changes.description: Settings has a clearer design, and Storage can remove recreatable caches, completed GPU archives, and old temporary exports.

changes.title: Direct launches skip Library loading
changes.description: Removed an early shortcut check that could still load the Library before a URL launch was handled.

changes.title: Widget updates refresh automatically
changes.description: Published snapshots request a widget refresh immediately. While a saved app with widgets is open, HTMLApp requests another refresh every five seconds and once more when you leave the app. iOS controls the final display timing.

changes.title: Better blank-widget diagnostics
changes.description: Widget diagnostics now show progress separately for each size, list installed widget kinds, and include a reversible plain-text rendering test to help identify blank widgets.

summary: Restore Forge 1.9.11 behavior and fix picked file fetches.

changes.title: Forge, back to familiar behavior
changes.description: Restored Forge’s generation and testing behavior from version 1.9.11, removing the stricter API checks and automatic fixers from the previous update.

changes.title: Read picked files inside apps
changes.description: Apps can fetch files selected through HTMLApp’s Files picker, including MP3s. Imported bytes are read in small chunks instead of relying on WebKit to fetch local file URLs.

changes.title: Widgets recover automatically
changes.description: HTMLApp automatically selects an accessible signing group shared with its widget extension when widget storage is unavailable. Missing signing permissions still require a correctly signed installation.

changes.title: Widget warnings stay visible
changes.description: On phones, widget publication errors appear at the top of the screen so they stay clear of the tab bar.

summary: Improve Forge local fixers, device guidance and shared controls.

changes.title: Smarter checks and repairs
changes.description: Forge fixes known API mistakes locally and checks generated apps for broken scripts, blocked buttons, and layout problems. Fast checks request a focused repair only when a problem is found.

changes.title: More consistent controls
changes.description: Forge has shared building blocks for switches, forms, tabs, and confirmation dialogs, with better touch targets and keyboard support.

changes.title: Better device compatibility
changes.description: Forge receives your system version and native API guidance. Browser face detection can use HTMLApp’s native Vision bridge, with bounded image sampling and permission handling.

summary: Rich Live Activities and configurable system controls.

changes.title: More expressive Live Activities
changes.description: Forge can add charts, waveforms, gauges, and routes to the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Timer activities can include Pause, Resume, and Complete actions.

changes.title: Your projects in Control Center
changes.description: On iOS 18 and later, add HTMLApp buttons and toggles, then choose a project and action for each. Find published controls in Widgets & Background.

summary: Fix Core ML model compilation.

changes.title: Real iOS controls in Forge apps
changes.description: Forge can open native settings sheets with switches, sliders, pickers, and text fields. On iOS 26 and later, they use Liquid Glass.

summary: Native Liquid Glass settings controls.

changes.title: Real iOS controls in Forge apps
changes.description: Forge can open native settings sheets with switches, sliders, pickers, and text fields. On iOS 26 and later, they use Liquid Glass.

summary: Offline 3D views, shared controls and GPU cleanup.

changes.title: Explore 3D objects
changes.description: Forge can add offline 3D views to projects. Drag to rotate, pinch to zoom, or open a local 3D model.

changes.title: Switches that fit
changes.description: Forge can reuse centered switches and settings rows. Layout checks catch clipping and misalignment across screen sizes.

changes.title: Automatic GPU file cleanup
changes.description: At startup, HTMLApp removes the oldest 10 eligible GPU cache folders once 20 collect. See the results in Settings → Storage.

summary: Fix zero storage readings and itemize Whisper models.

changes.title: See your actual storage use
changes.description: Storage now measures files more reliably and shows how much space the Whisper Offline model takes.

changes.title: Open apps faster
changes.description: Saved apps start without waiting for cache cleanup. Links and Home Screen icons switch apps in the same window.

summary: Show on-device storage and per-app file breakdown in Settings.

changes.title: See what takes up space
changes.description: Open Storage in Settings to see downloads, caches, and saved apps. Tap an app for its breakdown.

summary: Add compatible per-instance widget selection for iOS 16 and later.

changes.title: Compatible widget selection
changes.description: Add HTMLApp Compatible to choose a different app for each widget on iPhone and iPad, including iOS 16.2.

summary: Show concise release notes for only the current edit.

changes.title: Just this update
changes.description: What’s New now shows only the changes from the latest edit, with short, easy-to-read notes.

summary: Fix configurable widget refreshes and share configuration intents.

changes.title: Refresh configured widgets
changes.description: Published updates now refresh independently selected widgets as well as Primary. Widget selection has a shorter label and shared configuration support.

summary: Support independent widgets, four Home Screen sizes, and Live Activity handoff.

changes.title: Choose an app for each widget
changes.description: Add HTMLApp widgets for different saved apps together on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Edit each widget to choose its app on iOS 17 and later.

changes.title: All four Home Screen sizes
changes.description: Forge includes small, medium, large and extra-large iPad widgets. Older Home Screen publications gain compatible size fallbacks.

changes.title: Live Activities follow app requests
changes.description: When the active app requests a Live Activity, the previous app’s activity ends and the new one starts. Requests from old app sessions are rejected.

summary: Improved game QA, native tabs and API health checks.

changes.title: Check canvas rendering and frame rate
changes.description: Opt-in canvas checks flag blank game scenes during Forge QA, and running apps can measure visible-device frame cadence.

summary: Native Forge navigation and expanded runtime.

changes.title: Edits must make a change
changes.description: Forge uses the edit contract, retries unchanged output and missing requested native navigation, and restores the previous app when acceptance fails.

changes.title: Built-in navigation
changes.description: Apps can declare their screens once and let HTMLApp configure native tabs. Verification checks declared navigation and hidden preview fallbacks.

changes.title: More capable app foundations
changes.description: Bundled 3D, physics, charts, maps and audio libraries work with a package resource loader, portable modules and reusable game, canvas and sound helpers.

changes.title: More real data sources
changes.description: Forge selects relevant entries from a 168-provider catalog. Endpoint check results, credential requirements and provider-policy warnings stay explicit.

changes.title: Design richer Live Activities
changes.description: Arrange native text, symbols, timers, progress and shapes separately for the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Layout and payload limits are validated.

changes.title: Fresh sources when online
changes.description: Choose fresh online loading with offline fallback, network only, or standard browser caching. Bundled resources and saved app data remain local.

changes.title: Camera, models and native scenes
changes.description: New APIs support foreground camera frame files, compatible local Core ML image models, and bounded RealityKit scenes with optional AR.

changes.title: Native music and location history
changes.description: Apps can use a supplied sound bank, send MIDI channel messages, and explicitly enable bounded background location collection with Always permission.

changes.title: Live Activity controls
changes.description: Add Open and End controls to Live Activities. End uses a native App Intent on iOS 17 and later.

changes.title: Interactive maps and motion
changes.description: Apps can embed a native map with annotations and route geometry, and subscribe to foreground motion readings with explicit cleanup.

summary: Customizable native widgets and time formats.

changes.title: Design widgets your way
changes.description: Forge can arrange text, icons, images, shapes, rings and progress bars, with different layouts for each Home Screen and Lock Screen size.

changes.title: Choose what time shows
changes.description: Ask for hours and minutes, seconds only, or a countdown without seconds. iOS 18 and later support live selected units; older versions use compatible fallbacks.

changes.title: Centered Lock Screen timers
changes.description: Countdown text now fits inside circular widgets, with centered alignment and space around the ring.

summary: Fix private prompt access blocking compilation.

changes.title: Fixed a build error
changes.description: Corrected access to the original app request used by backend and widget validation.

summary: Generic time-range widgets and changes since 1.8.0.

changes.title: Widgets understand time
changes.description: Countdowns, elapsed timers and time progress use native displays. The same feature works for events, sessions, workouts and more, without constant app refreshes.

changes.title: Plan widget changes ahead
changes.description: Widgets can prepare Upcoming, In progress and Finished states from their start and end times. iOS controls when scheduled changes appear.

changes.title: Forge builds the backend too
changes.description: Forge checks for missing server code and matching app routes, then attempts repairs. Developer → Backend can repair an older incomplete app or connect its generated code using your saved secret.

changes.title: Work without Apple push setup
changes.description: Forge plans saved server messages, checks while the app is open and local reminders. It explains why instant remote alerts cannot be guaranteed while the app is closed.

changes.title: More reliable Lock Screen countdowns
changes.description: Published deadlines reach all widget sizes and native countdowns stop at zero. Backend status also shows the real API address and available notification support.

summary: Native widget countdowns and no-APNs Forge planning.

changes.title: Build around available notifications
changes.description: Forge uses saved server messages, foreground checks and local reminders when Apple push is unavailable, and explains background limits.

changes.title: Countdowns keep counting
changes.description: Event widgets use a native timer on the Home Screen and Lock Screen. They no longer need constant refreshes and stop at zero.

summary: Require complete Forge backends and fix v2 connection status.

changes.title: Forge builds the backend too
changes.description: Apps that need a server must include real backend code. Forge repairs missing pieces instead of calling a local-only demo finished.

changes.title: Repair existing backend apps
changes.description: Open Developer → Backend to repair an incomplete app with Forge or connect its generated server code using your saved secret.

changes.title: Clearer backend status
changes.description: Runtime apps show their real API address and server notification availability. You do not need provisioning JSON for automatic setup.

summary: Integrate generated Python backends with runtime v2.

changes.title: Build apps with real backends
changes.description: Forge can include custom Python server code. Saving deploys and checks the backend before saving your app.

changes.title: Share apps without control keys
changes.description: Nearby shares keep the public connection and leave out Python source and private management keys.

summary: Simplify automatic backends and remember microphone warning dismissal.

changes.title: Enter your secret and you’re connected
changes.description: Backend setup starts as soon as you enter your secret. Existing apps connect automatically, and new apps connect when you open or save them.

changes.title: The microphone warning appears once
changes.description: Dismiss the music warning once to keep using the microphone. HTMLApp remembers your choice after you close it.

summary: Automatically connect backends for existing apps.

changes.title: Connect existing apps automatically
changes.description: Open Developer → Backend for an app that needs cloud storage or notifications. HTMLApp uses your paired VPS to create and link its backend, including for imported apps.

summary: Provision and link Forge backends automatically.

changes.title: Backends link automatically
changes.description: Pair your VPS once in Settings. When you save a Forge app that needs a backend, HTMLApp creates and links it for you. If you’re offline, it retries when you return.

summary: Link approved Hostish backends to saved apps.

changes.title: Connect your apps to a backend
changes.description: Open Developer → Backend to link a server template, see its details and keys, and manage its saved data.

changes.title: Send notifications from a webhook
changes.description: Link a notification backend and register your phone. Use its send-only key from your website or automation.

changes.title: Backend access stays private
changes.description: Nearby transfers leave out backend keys and Python source. Deleting a linked app also queues its backend for deletion.

summary: Keep embedded icons out of AI edit context.

changes.title: Large icons stay out of AI edits
changes.description: HTMLApp keeps embedded app icons out of edit requests, leaving more room for your app code. Your saved icon is kept.

summary: Use direct edit prompts and clear outgoing native tabs.

changes.title: Edits use your own words
changes.description: Forge sends your edit as you wrote or spoke it. New app ideas can still be refined before building.

changes.title: Tabs stay with their app
changes.description: Opening a different saved app from the Home Screen clears the previous app’s tab bar.

summary: Start Library voice builds directly and review Whisper prompts.

changes.title: Start building from the Library mic
changes.description: Release the mic to start your app without opening the prompt form. Turn on Show styles for Library voice creation in Settings if you want previews first.

changes.title: Check what Whisper heard
changes.description: Your words appear briefly after transcription. Tap them to make a correction and send.

changes.title: Pause music before dictating
changes.description: If another app is playing audio, HTMLApp asks you to pause it before opening the microphone.

summary: Fit microphone glass and animate the drag return.

changes.title: Chat with Apple Intelligence
changes.description: Saved apps can send recent chat messages to Apple Intelligence and display an answer generated on your device. Turn on generated-app AI access in Settings.

changes.title: Music while styles are made
changes.description: Your generation music now plays during style previews. If you leave HTMLApp and the previews finish, you can get a notification.

changes.title: A better guide for external AI
changes.description: The app-building guide now explains local devices, chat, dictation, native tabs and Liquid Glass.

changes.title: Speak an app idea from Library
changes.description: Drag the Library microphone inward, speak, and release. If style previews are on, Forge shows designs first. If they are off, Forge starts building.

changes.title: The edit mic follows your finger
changes.description: Drag the mic in any direction. When you release it, it stretches and springs back as the editor opens. On iOS 26, the glass fits inside the outline and turns a translucent red while recording.

changes.title: The same edit mic in both places
changes.description: The saved-app mic now matches the tilted mic in Edit with AI. Both use Apple’s Liquid Glass on iOS 26 and later.

changes.title: Real Liquid Glass for saved apps
changes.description: On iOS 26 and later, apps can add a native glass surface to a small area of the screen. The glass lets taps pass through.

summary: Match the editor microphone and expose native Liquid Glass.

changes.title: The same edit mic in both places
changes.description: The saved-app mic now matches the tilted mic in Edit with AI. Both use Apple’s Liquid Glass on iOS 26 and later.

changes.title: Real Liquid Glass for saved apps
changes.description: On iOS 26 and later, apps can add a native glass surface to a small area of the screen. The glass lets taps pass through.

summary: Restore drag-to-edit dictation and start edits sooner.

changes.title: Drag, speak, then release
changes.description: Drag the edge mic inward, hold it while you speak, and release to start the edit. Long dictation keeps earlier words when Apple Speech starts a new segment.

changes.title: Edits start sooner
changes.description: Apply Change and voice edits skip the extra planning check for ordinary edits. Full rewrites still ask you first.

summary: Explain recent changes in What's New.

changes.title: AI edits are easier to follow
changes.description: Edit summaries tell you what changed in a short sentence. Forge uses the app around your edit to better understand short requests and protect features you want to keep.

changes.title: More reliable app generation
changes.description: Forge catches cut-off answers and incomplete edits before using them. Stopping a request also stops its retries.

changes.title: More variety in app designs
changes.description: Forge can try more creative layouts and add motion where it helps. Compare previews with the numbered buttons on the right. The text below the preview is gone.

changes.title: Tabs follow the screen
changes.description: In apps that use the new navigation, opening a screen from a button also highlights its tab. Apps can use any system icon available on your device. Missing icons show an app icon instead of a square.

changes.title: A glass look for app controls
changes.description: Apps can give toolbars and other controls a see-through, frosted look. The effect respects your Reduce Transparency setting.

changes.title: Pick up where you left off
changes.description: Opening a different app saves the previous app’s screen. When you return, it restores automatically. If you close HTMLApp from the app switcher, the app you had open starts fresh next time.

changes.title: Your voice setting works in saved apps
changes.description: Apps that use dictation follow your choice of Apple Speech or Whisper in Settings. Whisper prepares while you speak, and Forge can retry a failed transcription using the same recording.

changes.title: Keep the edit mic within reach
changes.description: Turn on Show edit microphone at all times in Settings. A small part of the mic stays visible at the edge of your phone screen. Tap it or drag it inward to start a voice edit.

changes.title: Widgets follow the app you open
changes.description: When you open an app with widgets, its widgets become the default. The change appears when iOS refreshes them.

changes.title: Find recent apps faster in car display
changes.description: The launcher shows app icons with the most recently opened apps first.

summary: Improve app switching, dictation and Forge presentation.

changes.title: More expressive previews
changes.description: Compare designs with numbered controls and read shorter AI edit summaries.

changes.title: Dictation where you need it
changes.description: Saved apps follow your dictation setting, and you can pin a voice edit shortcut to the edge.

changes.title: Smoother app switching
changes.description: Switching apps saves the previous screen for automatic restoration and makes the opened app’s widgets the default.

summary: Sync managed app screens with native tabs.

changes.title: Screens and tabs stay in sync
changes.description: Generated apps can use a built-in screen router so opening a tab destination from a button also selects its native tab.

summary: Keep tied partial edit targets ambiguous.

changes.title: Smarter small edits
changes.description: Forge ranks specific screen and component matches, avoids accidental Bluetooth matches in ordinary words, and keeps broader context for ambiguous or functional edits.

changes.title: Safer generation and patches
changes.description: Incomplete provider responses and unfinished patch blocks are rejected. Cancelled requests stop retrying, and visual edits protect existing screens, routes and native integrations.

changes.title: More thoughtful app generation
changes.description: Updated generation guidance emphasizes complete workflows from short prompts, native iOS interactions, keyboard and accessibility behavior, reliable saving and recovery.

summary: Improve Forge intent, native app guidance and generation reliability.

changes.title: Smarter small edits
changes.description: Forge ranks specific screen and component matches, avoids accidental Bluetooth matches in ordinary words, and keeps broader context for ambiguous or functional edits.

changes.title: Safer generation and patches
changes.description: Incomplete provider responses and unfinished patch blocks are rejected. Cancelled requests stop retrying, and visual edits protect existing screens, routes and native integrations.

changes.title: More thoughtful app generation
changes.description: Updated generation guidance emphasizes complete workflows from short prompts, native iOS interactions, keyboard and accessibility behavior, reliable saving and recovery.

summary: Enforce consented network boundaries for background refresh.

changes.title: Background sync now honors network permissions
changes.description: Scheduled JSON refreshes require saved-app network approval and a separately approved public DNS host. Background requests use the same bounded, no-redirect, public-address-checked HTTPS transport as foreground APIs.

changes.title: Optional APNs-triggered refresh
changes.description: When HTMLApp is properly signed for APNs and iOS delivers a content-available notification, the host can refresh only due, consented background jobs. Apple controls delivery and no background JavaScript is executed.

changes.title: Stricter background API contracts
changes.description: The generated native bridge now requires the background job ID, public HTTPS URL and storage key and declares its network permission, helping Forge generate safer refresh behavior.

summary: Add forward geocoding, offline distance and network path events.

changes.title: Search addresses with Apple's geocoder
changes.description: Saved apps can look up approximate coordinates for a user-entered address or place through HTMLAppNative.location.geocode(). This needs location permission but does not request the device's GPS position.

changes.title: Calculate distance without GPS
changes.description: HTMLAppNative.location.distance() computes straight-line great-circle distance between two supplied coordinate pairs entirely offline, without location permission.

changes.title: Wi-Fi and cellular connection awareness
changes.description: HTMLAppNative.network.status() provides passive iOS network-path state and sends change events, allowing saved apps to display offline and constrained-network conditions without requesting a domain.

changes.title: Native API signatures stay in sync
changes.description: The new methods are part of the canonical generated native bridge, TypeScript contract, Forge capability planning and automated argument tests.

summary: Fail closed on unverified Forge mobile style previews.

changes.title: No more unchecked tiny preview sketches
changes.description: Forge now refuses to approve a style if the mobile WebView times out or cannot be measured. Its layout checker always evaluates a real 320-point phone viewport and regenerates layouts that are too wide or unreadable.

changes.title: ZIP import compatibility checks
changes.description: Backups now have automated tests against normal and streaming Deflate ZIPs, bad CRCs, duplicate entries, excessive file counts, unsafe paths and exports.

summary: Extract portable ZIP engine and test real compressed backups.

changes.title: More reliable HTMLApp backups
changes.description: ZIP handling is now isolated in a small tested module. Automated macOS tests check compressed archives, data descriptors, integrity failures, duplicate entries, path traversal and backup round trips.

changes.title: Import tested across phone and tablet
changes.description: The continuous UI test matrix exercises the root Import screen on both iPhone and iPad simulators. Actual Files and Share Sheet handoff still depends on iOS delivery and signing.

summary: Teach Forge generated native API types, cache plans and estimate stage cost.

changes.title: Forge knows the exact native APIs
changes.description: Forge now includes the schema-generated TypeScript native contract in its generation and editing prompts, helping prevent invented device methods and incorrect argument shapes.

changes.title: Less repeated planning work
changes.description: Retrying an identical app idea can reuse an in-memory planning result from the prior twelve minutes, avoiding unnecessary repeated provider calls without saving prompts to disk.

changes.title: Optional AI work cost estimates
changes.description: Advanced AI Settings now lets you enter an output-token price, and the Forge stage timeline shows a clearly labeled approximate output-only cost. Estimates are not actual bills and exclude other token charges.

changes.title: Smarter native bridge checks
changes.description: Forge also checks literal native RPC method names against the generated registry while recognizing supported higher-level SDK helpers.

summary: Add native UIKit list sheets and pull-to-refresh events.

changes.title: Native lists and sheets for generated apps
changes.description: Generated HTML apps can now present genuine UIKit list sheets with accessible rows, selected-item results and native sheet transitions instead of relying only on web-styled dialogs.

changes.title: Pull to refresh native lists
changes.description: Optional native pull-to-refresh emits an event to the saved app, which can publish updated rows using HTMLAppNative.ui.listUpdate(). Lists are foreground-only and isolated per saved app.

changes.title: On-device semantic search
changes.description: App-private SQLite documents can now be searched by semantic similarity using installed Apple NaturalLanguage sentence embeddings, with no cloud service required.

summary: Add private on-device sentence-vector search to SQLite.

changes.title: Private semantic document search
changes.description: Saved HTML apps can search their own SQLite notes by meaning using Apple's on-device sentence embeddings. The indexed vectors remain on the device and are updated when records change.

changes.title: Search that respects device capability
changes.description: Semantic search reports when a device lacks an embedding model instead of using cloud AI silently. Existing exact and full-text SQLite search remain available as fallbacks.

changes.title: More readable generated style previews
changes.description: Forge now checks real WebKit layout geometry for overflow or unreadably tiny text before offering a look, and retries when the sketch is broken.

summary: Validate Forge look geometry and add iPhone/iPad import UI tests.

changes.title: Bad style sketches now get repaired
changes.description: Forge tests generated style previews in a real offscreen 320-point WebKit viewport. Offscreen content or unreadably small text triggers another design attempt before the look can be offered.

changes.title: Simulator import tests
changes.description: A new simulator UI test target exercises HTMLApp launch, a staged external HTML open, and a Share-extension inbox import on both iPhone and iPad. Tests are available in a dedicated GitHub Actions workflow.

changes.title: Continued native improvements
changes.description: Saved apps now support AI tool conversations, live token streaming, structured on-device model responses, approved cloud fallback, and a Share-sheet import inbox.

summary: Apple Foundation Models guided answers and consented cloud fallback.

changes.title: Reliable on-device structured answers
changes.description: On iOS 26 with Foundation Models, saved apps can request typed answer, summary and confidence fields using Apple's native guided generation instead of relying on unvalidated text JSON.

changes.title: Optional, clearly approved cloud fallback
changes.description: If the on-device model cannot answer, saved apps can request a one-time fallback to the configured cloud provider. HTMLApp asks for explicit confirmation before sending the current prompt.

changes.title: Documented local AI limits
changes.description: The bridge's contract now validates local AI inputs and documents when answers stay on-device versus when a user-confirmed fallback uses a cloud provider.

summary: Add iOS Share extension and App Group HTML import inbox.

changes.title: Share HTML straight into HTMLApp
changes.description: A new iOS Share extension receives HTML file attachments into a secure shared inbox and attempts to open the app. If iOS does not allow automatic launch, the file is ready to import the next time you open HTMLApp.

changes.title: Import requests survive app switching
changes.description: HTMLApp now checks the shared inbox when it opens or returns to the foreground, presenting the New App or Update Existing import destination for staged documents.

changes.title: Watch saved-app AI answer live
changes.description: Live token streaming and bounded, confirmation-gated AI conversations are now available for generated HTML apps with authorized AI access.

summary: Stream genuine AI tokens into saved apps with cancellation.

changes.title: Live AI responses in saved apps
changes.description: Generated apps can now receive live provider tokens through HTMLAppNative.ai.stream(), display them as they arrive and cancel with AbortSignal. Streams stay inside the saved app's permitted foreground AI session.

changes.title: AI can ask to use native tools
changes.description: Short, in-memory AI conversations can call selected calendars, reminders, health, location and saved-document methods with fresh permission confirmation before sensitive data goes to the provider.

changes.title: Safer cancellation and request limits
changes.description: Foreground AI streaming follows the existing per-app permission, request budget, response-size limits and request cancellation, with no promises of background streaming.

summary: Bounded in-app AI conversations with confirmed native tools.

changes.title: AI sessions with confirmed native tools
changes.description: Saved apps can now create short AI conversations that request selected calendar, reminders, health, battery, location, and private document tools. Every sensitive tool call requires a new user confirmation before private results can reach the AI provider.

changes.title: Private, short-lived AI conversation context
changes.description: Each in-app AI session retains its recent messages only in the open WebView. Sessions include explicit clear and cancellation support and do not persist secrets or conversation history.

changes.title: Search locally saved documents
changes.description: Generated apps can search their own SQLite documents using indexed token search or the original substring search without sharing data with outside services.

summary: Add on-device SQLite FTS5 for saved HTML apps.

changes.title: Fast on-device full-text search
changes.description: Saved HTML apps can search stored JSON documents with token-ranked SQLite FTS5 using HTMLAppNative.db.searchFullText(). Indexing is local, created on demand, and updates with documents.

changes.title: Files import and look previews improved
changes.description: Opening or sharing an HTML document now queues the root Import screen, while Forge's style previews use full-width mobile layouts instead of squeezed side-by-side views.

changes.title: Safer networking and backup files
changes.description: Native HTTPS checks nonpublic addresses and ZIP import validates checksums, sizes, and ordinary Deflate archives while preserving cache paths.

summary: Root-owned HTML imports, responsive style previews, safer HTTPS and ZIP archives.

changes.title: Files and shared HTML now open Import
changes.description: Incoming HTML files open the import destination screen from the app root, including cold launches and files shared from Files. The app also recognizes the .htmk file extension.

changes.title: Readable, full-width Forge previews
changes.description: Generated style mockups now use the full screen width with look choices below, correct mobile viewport scaling and responsive layout guidance, reducing tiny or clipped previews.

changes.title: Safer native HTTPS requests
changes.description: Native requests now screen DNS answers against private and local addresses and verify connection-address metadata before returning a response, with blocked redirects and stricter host-name checks.

changes.title: More compatible, safer backups
changes.description: Backup import now accepts standard Deflate ZIP archives, checks file integrity, rejects duplicate paths, limits archive size and handles ZIP data descriptors. Export preserves nested cache paths correctly.

summary: Show visible microphone and Whisper retry progress.

changes.title: See microphone and transcription retries
changes.description: The floating Forge microphone now displays clear retrying status while it reconnects to the microphone or reuses captured audio to retry Whisper transcription, without blocking your drag gesture.

changes.title: Better-looking popup edits
changes.description: Forge detects when a redesign misaligns labels and fields, requests a corrected layout, and respects later fixes that replace the old CSS grid.

changes.title: Your spoken edits stay recoverable
changes.description: Whisper automatically retries the original recorded audio, lets you retry the saved recording after a decoding failure, and routes recovered words back to the intended app edit.

summary: Accept corrected dialog form layouts after CSS overrides.

changes.title: More reliable popup redesigns
changes.description: Forge now recognizes when a corrected layout replaces an older bad grid rule, so valid repairs are accepted without breaking label and input alignment.

changes.title: Retry speech without repeating it
changes.description: Whisper keeps the captured audio through multiple automatic transcription retries and provides a Retry using saved audio option if needed. Recovered speech still applies to the original edit or style-feedback action.

changes.title: AI edits catch broken dialog layouts
changes.description: Visual changes that split labels from fields or produce no actual source change trigger a corrective patch attempt rather than being reported as finished.

summary: Keep Whisper retry intent and corrected visual edit metadata.

changes.title: Visual edits respect your forms
changes.description: Forge now detects broken multi-column layouts that split labels away from their fields, then retries the visual patch from the original app. It preserves existing data and behavior instead of approving a visually broken change.

changes.title: Voice edits recover without repeating speech
changes.description: Whisper keeps your recorded audio through automatic transcription retries, can reload its speech model, and offers Retry using saved audio if decoding still fails. Successful retries return to the original edit or style feedback action.

changes.title: Smarter microphone retries
changes.description: Transient microphone startup problems show a retrying status while HTMLApp attempts to start recording again.

summary: Repair weak popup redesigns and retry Whisper on saved audio.

changes.title: Cleaner, more reliable AI edits
changes.description: Forge now checks visual edits for broken form layouts, duplicate dialog copy, and unchanged output. When a popup redesign misplaces labels and fields, Forge asks the editor to repair the patch instead of accepting the broken result.

changes.title: Whisper retries without making you repeat yourself
changes.description: If Whisper cannot decode a recorded voice edit, it retries the same saved audio automatically and can reload its model. A Retry using saved audio action remains available if all attempts fail.

changes.title: Clearer microphone recovery
changes.description: Transient microphone-start failures now report that recording is retrying, while the microphone only indicates active capture once recording actually starts.

summary: Current product improvements and version-bump guard.

changes.title: HTML files now open into Import reliably
changes.description: Opening an HTML file from Files or sharing one to HTMLApp now stages the document safely and keeps the import request until the Library is ready, including cold launches and the What's New screen.

changes.title: Simpler Settings
changes.description: Everyday settings are grouped around AI & Voice, Library, iCloud, Manage, and Help, while developer and rarely used controls are tucked into Advanced Settings.

changes.title: Watch Apple Speech appear live
changes.description: During Forge edits, dragging the floating microphone on-screen now shows the words you are speaking in large live captions while Apple Speech recognizes them.

changes.title: More native media and UI capabilities
changes.description: Saved apps can use permission-scoped native audio recording and playback, foreground camera video capture, and the native iOS color picker through the documented bridge.

changes.title: Smarter Forge editing contracts
changes.description: Forge now keeps versioned app architecture metadata and uses semantic capability planning to preserve storage, screens, routes, native features, and regression requirements across edits.

changes.title: One native bridge contract
changes.description: The native RPC surface now comes from one generated schema that drives Swift registration, argument checks, API documentation, TypeScript definitions, and consistency tests.

summary: Keep 1.6.56 (64) for build-only compiler fix.

changes.title: Experimental offline app snapshots
changes.description: Saved HTML apps now collect eligible external GET resources while you use them and refresh their offline snapshot every third opening. When your device is offline, HTMLApp can use those saved resources and clearly tells you that an experimental offline copy is active.

changes.title: Pick up where you left off
changes.description: HTMLApp now checkpoints the live state of saved apps, including the rendered page, scroll positions, typed form values, editable content, local and session storage, canvas pixels, focused controls, and media position. Switching back during the same HTMLApp session restores automatically; after a later cold launch, HTMLApp asks before restoring.

changes.title: Faster app-to-app URL switching
changes.description: htmlapp://open links now save the current app state and switch directly to the requested saved app, instead of stopping on the normal app-switch confirmation.

changes.title: More reliable first three AI looks
changes.description: Forge again uses the structured Editorial, Workbench, and Playful directions for the first three generated previews, improving consistency while keeping additional style generations freeform.

changes.title: First three previews generate automatically
changes.description: Starting a new Forge app now automatically creates the first three style previews so you can compare directions before the full app is built.

changes.title: Build with a subscription AI
changes.description: AI & Creation includes a shareable HTMLApp skill file that explains HTMLApp capabilities, native integrations, offline limits, and how an external subscription AI can return complete HTML apps without configuring an API key inside HTMLApp.

changes.title: Smarter hosted HTML importing
changes.description: When an imported HTML file depends on root-relative server APIs such as /api/build, HTMLApp now explains why an offline file cannot contain the backend and offers the hosted Website Import path instead of silently treating the API URL like a static asset.

changes.title: Clearer, more reliable dictation
changes.description: Offline Whisper recording retries transient microphone start failures automatically. The mic turns red only while recording and grows while held so its state stays visible under your finger.

summary: Build test compatibility fix; Experimental offline resource snapshots; Live app state continuity.

changes.title: Build test compatibility fix
changes.description: Updated stale style-preview source assertions to recognize the restored first three layouts and made release tests dynamic.

summary: Update HTMLApp to 1.6.54 (62) for offline snapshots and live state continuity.

changes.title: Experimental offline resource snapshots
changes.description: Saved apps refresh external GET resources every third opening and collect loaded resources during use. Cached copies activate only while offline and show a warning when used.

changes.title: Live app state continuity
changes.description: HTMLApp preserves scroll position, typed controls, web storage and the current rendered HTML while switching apps, with a restore choice after a later cold launch.

changes.title: Instant URL-scheme switching
changes.description: htmlapp://open links now checkpoint the current app and switch directly to the requested saved app.

summary: Update HTMLApp to 1.6.53 (61) for restored style quality and automatic previews.

changes.title: Reliable first three Forge looks
changes.description: Restored the structured first-three style system for more consistent app quality, while keeping additional looks freeform.

changes.title: Three previews automatically
changes.description: New app generation now always starts by creating the first three style previews automatically.

summary: Update HTMLApp to 1.6.52 (60) after dynamic release invariant repair.

changes.title: Release test fix
changes.description: Source invariants now validate the current compiled version dynamically instead of failing after every version bump.

summary: Update HTMLApp to 1.6.51 (59) after build runner invariant fix.

changes.title: Build workflow compatibility fix
changes.description: Updated build source checks for selectable Intel and Apple Silicon macOS runners while retaining the Xcode 26 compatibility requirement.

summary: Update release metadata to 1.6.50 (58) for selectable build runners.

changes.title: Selectable IPA build runner
changes.description: The manual GitHub Actions IPA workflow offers Intel macOS 26 by default, Apple Silicon macOS 26, and Intel macOS 15 to work around runner queue delays.

summary: Bundle downloadable HTMLApp skill and bump release to 1.6.49 (57).

changes.title: Shareable AI app-building skill
changes.description: AI & Creation now includes a downloadable skill explaining how a subscription AI assistant can build HTMLApp-compatible apps without an API key.

changes.title: Safer hosted HTML importing
changes.description: When an HTML file depends on server-side API routes, HTMLApp explains why offline imports cannot run the server and offers Website Import.

changes.title: Open HTML files in HTMLApp
changes.description: HTMLApp remains registered as an HTML document handler for iOS Open In and Files.

summary: Register HTMLApp as HTML document handler and bump 1.6.48 (56).
Add car display compatibility and flexible AI styles (1.6.47 build 55).

changes.title: Car display mode
changes.description: A compact app launcher, visible Apps exit, safe display bounds and adaptive HTML runtime for setups that already launch HTMLApp on a car screen. Enable Car display in the Library menu when your mirroring tool reports an iPhone screen. This is compatibility mode, not Apple's native CarPlay templates.

changes.title: More creative looks
changes.description: Modern/professional, technical/detailed and kiddy/easy-to-use are broad directions. AI chooses the composition freely. Look choices scroll vertically above the selection controls.

summary: Whisper startup retry and hold-to-record feedback.

changes.title: Reliable Whisper microphone
changes.description: Transient microphone startup failures retry automatically while the user keeps holding, without another manual attempt.

changes.title: Clear recording indicator
changes.description: The microphone turns red only after recording begins, and enlarges while held to make its state more visible.

summary: Smarter Forge planning; Optional visual taste memory; HealthKit date ranges.

changes.title: Smarter Forge planning
changes.description: Provider-gated creative sampling and planner-specific reasoning improve design planning without changing reliable coding defaults.

changes.title: Optional visual taste memory
changes.description: Learn small style preferences from selected designs and edits when enabled, with a clear settings switch and reset option.

changes.title: HealthKit date ranges
changes.description: Generated apps can request permission to inspect bounded HealthKit history with accurate missing-data states.

changes.title: NFC text writing
changes.description: User-confirmed writes to compatible NDEF tags now include capacity and writable-status checks.

changes.title: Native document and image tools
changes.description: VisionKit scanning, PDF page/text inspection and file-backed Core Image filters add media functions without large WebKit data messages.

changes.title: Bluetooth GATT controls
changes.description: Bounded read, confirmed write and foreground notification subscriptions for discovered BLE devices, with app-exit cleanup.

changes.title: Custom haptics
changes.description: Generated apps can play bounded Core Haptics patterns on supported devices.

changes.title: On-device AI for saved apps
changes.description: Eligible iOS 26 devices can grant permission for short local Foundation Models text and JSON responses without cloud API requests.

changes.title: Gamepads and drawing
changes.description: Generated apps can listen to foreground game controller events and open a native PencilKit canvas with sandboxed image output.

summary: Smarter Forge instructions and voice; Photo bridge build fix; Reliable multi-photo imports.

changes.title: Smarter Forge instructions and voice
changes.description: Reordered stable AI capability instructions for provider prompt caching, added punctuation and app vocabulary to voice dictation, and expanded native bridge argument checks.

summary: Photo bridge build fix; Reliable multi-photo imports; Reliable bulk photo import.

changes.title: Photo bridge build fix
changes.description: Fixed injected JavaScript syntax in the photo importer and made bridge script tests work without a browser fetch implementation.

summary: Reliable multi-photo imports; Reliable bulk photo import; Road lookup resilience.

changes.title: Reliable multi-photo imports
changes.description: Photo import now transfers originals to generated apps in bounded WebKit chunks and prefers native file representations without unnecessary conversion. Large selections no longer require one enormous bridge response.

summary: Reliable bulk photo import; Road lookup resilience; Road data diagnostics.

changes.title: Reliable bulk photo import
changes.description: Native photo picks now stage files without blocking the UI and load originals on demand, preventing oversized selection callbacks.

summary: Road lookup resilience; Road data diagnostics; Spotlight indexing.

changes.title: Road lookup resilience
changes.description: Road speed lookups now return an explicit cooling-down status rather than immediate failures on repeated GPS fixes, and favor nearby roads with speed tags.

summary: Road data diagnostics; Spotlight indexing; Search documents and run Shortcuts actions.

changes.title: Road data diagnostics
changes.description: Improved mapped road lookup failure reporting and reduced throttling after provider outages. Each new source update now increments the release identity.

summary: Build 45 for opt-in Spotlight search indexing.

changes.title: Spotlight indexing
changes.description: Saved apps can request permission to index, remove, and clear their own searchable titles and summaries.

summary: Build 44 for database search and Shortcuts delivery.

changes.title: Search documents and run Shortcuts actions
changes.description: Saved apps can search their local documents and consume pending named actions from Siri Shortcuts.

summary: Portable data and Shortcuts.

changes.title: Portable app data and Shortcuts
changes.description: SQLite document snapshots can be bundled with portable app data, and Shortcuts can request a named saved-app action.

summary: Added a local SQLite document API.

changes.title: Local document database
changes.description: Saved apps can now store, retrieve, list, count, and delete JSON documents in an isolated SQLite database.

summary: Vision API additions.

changes.title: On-device image analysis
changes.description: Saved HTML apps can recognize text and barcodes, classify images, and detect face rectangles using Apple Vision.

summary: On-device language tools; AI in saved apps; Adaptive shake exit.

changes.title: On-device language tools
changes.description: Saved HTML apps can detect languages, tokenize text, analyze sentiment and extract named entities using Apple NaturalLanguage.

summary: AI in saved apps; Adaptive shake exit; On-demand native capability research.

changes.title: AI in saved apps
changes.description: Opt-in per-app AI completion and classification with permission checks and request limits. Experimental compact-output preference added.

summary: Improved app exit transitions and expanded native device APIs.

changes.title: Street addresses and road data
changes.description: Saved apps can resolve approximate street addresses via Apple geocoding and, with separate consent, request optional OpenStreetMap road speed tags. Unavailable data is never guessed.

changes.title: Offline Forge (experimental)
changes.description: Eligible iOS 26 devices can use on-device Apple Intelligence for small app generation and editing after a clear effort-and-battery warning.

changes.title: Safer portable storage
changes.description: App data writes now report disk errors instead of falsely succeeding; clearing data produces an explicit iCloud-syncable empty state.

changes.title: App storage inspection (experimental)
changes.description: The app permissions screen now offers a developer storage inspector with portable data and SQLite document removal warnings.

changes.title: AI and QA reliability fixes
changes.description: Improved provider endpoint normalization, native request timeouts, offscreen touch tests, and missing Health data reporting.

changes.title: Health, NFC and native maps (experimental)
changes.description: Saved apps can request read-only daily Health totals, foreground NFC NDEF scans, and a native map modal. Supported devices and signing entitlements are required.

changes.title: Speech recognition API compatibility
changes.description: Saved HTML apps can call speech.recognize and speech.stopRecognizing through the existing permission-controlled foreground transcription engine.

changes.title: Generated app API checks
changes.description: Runtime verification now reports unsupported native bridge method calls and Web Bluetooth requestDevice usage.

changes.title: Native bridge reliability
changes.description: Corrected duplicate Vision dispatch patterns and added source regression checks.

changes.title: Adaptive shake exit
changes.description: The exit fade uses the last resting phone orientation sampled every three seconds; the torch flash uses a gentler intensity.

summary: Added on-demand native capability lookup.

changes.title: On-demand native capability research
changes.description: Forge can request the complete HTMLApp capability catalog or focused sections such as Bluetooth, widgets, tabs, and device information before generating or editing apps.

summary: Added motion settings.

changes.title: Custom motion settings
changes.description: Set the shake time and, in Developer Mode, the fade disappearance angle. Settings displays the selected values.

summary: Fixed shake gesture completion.

changes.title: More reliable face-down shake
changes.description: Shake progress now accumulates across natural motion impulses instead of requiring uninterrupted acceleration, allowing the exit animation and flashlight cue to trigger.

summary: Shake exit build validation; Build validation for native tabs; Native tabs stay inside apps.

changes.title: Shake exit build validation
changes.description: Regression tests now protect the new fade and flashlight exit flow instead of requiring the removed legacy gesture handler.

summary: Corrected native tab build checks.

changes.title: Build validation for native tabs
changes.description: Updated the source regression check to require tab bars to remain inside their HTML app instead of appearing in editing screens.

summary: Fixed tab containment and shake transitions.

changes.title: Native tabs stay inside apps
changes.description: The real native tab bar no longer mounts onto the global app screen while editing.

changes.title: Shake exit transition improvements
changes.description: A dedicated overlay window keeps the black-and-blurred fade visible while returning to the Library.

changes.title: Exit flashlight cue
changes.description: The shake-exit flashlight now targets the rear torch for a short pulse after closing an HTML app.

summary: Added music source switching.

changes.title: Two ways to add generation music
changes.description: Switch between picking an audio file from Files and downloading audio from a direct HTTPS URL. Your previous audio URL is preserved.

changes.title: Recent HTMLApp improvements
changes.description: Includes the updated face-down shake exit, AI generation controls, photo compatibility, and improved app sharing.

summary: Face-down shake exit; Photo picker compatibility; Choose generation music from Files.

changes.title: Face-down shake exit
changes.description: Shake a face-down iPhone to close the running HTML app, with a flashlight cue and a black-and-blurred screen that fades as you rotate it.

changes.title: Photo picker compatibility
changes.description: Selected images are easier for both new and older HTML apps to display.

changes.title: Choose generation music from Files
changes.description: Pick a local audio track instead of entering a URL, with clearer guidance for background generation.

changes.title: More AI generation controls
changes.description: Add three original AI looks, speed up a run with Hurry Up!, undo unsaved edits and approve rare full rewrites.

changes.title: Generation progress in Dynamic Island
changes.description: See the active AI phase and progress while a Live Activity is running.

changes.title: Organized app actions
changes.description: App menus group everyday actions, sharing and developer tools. Raw code exports use HTML files.

summary: More dependable generation audio; Flip and shake to close; Up to seven native tabs.

changes.title: More dependable generation audio
changes.description: Music URL prefetch and safer dictation teardown reduce interruptions. Experimental silent audio is optional; background processing remains best-effort.

changes.title: Flip and shake to close
changes.description: An optional face-down shake returns from a saved app to Library.

changes.title: Up to seven native tabs
changes.description: Apps can request compact UIKit tabs with badges, JavaScript selection callbacks and animations.

changes.title: Quieter permissions
changes.description: Repeated requests are coalesced and abusive prompts are blocked, with permissions shown in a simpler list.

summary: Privacy tools, widget actions and battery API.

changes.title: AI Generation Privacy
changes.description: Control whether Forge may use location, date, device, calendar, reminders or public HTTPS research. All permissions default off.

changes.title: Actionable app widgets
changes.description: Generated widgets can open specific screens or deliver validated action context through signed links.

changes.title: Battery and thermal APIs
changes.description: HTML apps can read charging status, battery percentage and thermal state.

changes.title: Simpler creation screen
changes.description: Quick mode controls appear only when Manual policy is selected; debug model and UI polish status labels are hidden.

summary: Build 27 for generation and workflow improvements.

changes.title: Longer background playback
changes.description: Generation Music uses primary audio playback and safer background request handoffs when audio is interrupted.

changes.title: Automatic Quick mode
changes.description: Choose Manual or Automatic AI speed selection, with the option to override the recommendation.

changes.title: Faster planning and clearer intent
changes.description: Forge produces shorter planning briefs and suggests an editable purpose during style selection.

changes.title: Faster opening and setup
changes.description: App launching avoids a synchronous Library rewrite, and Home Screen installation now offers additional recovery options.

changes.title: A shorter welcome tour
changes.description: Five introduction cards plus optional permissions replace the long setup walkthrough.

summary: Generation Music; Faster QUICK! creation; Instant style choices.

changes.title: More original AI looks
changes.description: Regenerated looks use genuinely different layout archetypes, not just different colors.

changes.title: JavaScript error assistant
changes.description: A warning icon in Forge preview can show runtime errors and offer to ask AI for a fix.

summary: Generation Music; Faster QUICK! creation; Instant style choices.

changes.title: Generation Music
changes.description: Play your own linked audio during Forge creation and editing, with cached playback, volume and preview controls.

changes.title: Faster QUICK! creation
changes.description: QUICK! avoids optional web research and extra specialist icon regeneration.

changes.title: Instant style choices
changes.description: Three looks are immediately available while a small AI request can refine their product labels.

summary: Fix incomplete AI style previews with larger token budgets and model fallback (1.6.17).

changes.title: Complete AI style previews
changes.description: Forge gives preview models enough output budget to finish their HTML and retries incomplete specialist results using the main app model.

changes.title: Clearer provider diagnostics
changes.description: AI Debug now shows response finish reasons and token usage when the provider includes them, helping identify truncated mockups.

summary: Improve iOS 16 voice widget routing, Forge mockups, QUICK mode and URL imports (1.6.16).

changes.title: More reliable Lock Screen voice launch
changes.description: Cold-start widget links reopen Forge, begin recording, then switch to hold-to-talk after you tap Stop.

changes.title: More relevant AI style previews
changes.description: Forge requests mockups for your exact idea and system light or dark appearance. Offline sketches now show realistic product content.

changes.title: QUICK! generation and optional skips
